items.followUp: Explain star topology and bus topology.

rubric.why: Describes how the computers are arranged in a ring topology.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that computers form a closed loop or are connected to two neighboring computers.

accept: passes from one computer to another
rubric.why: Explains how data is transmitted in a ring topology.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that data passes from computer to computer around the ring.

accept: every computer is connected to every other computer
rubric.why: Describes the direct connections in a mesh topology.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that computers have direct links, or that in a full mesh each computer connects to every other computer.

rubric.why: Gives a valid characteristic of mesh topology.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for noting its reliability or that it needs many connections and is expensive.

modelAnswer: In Ring Topology, each computer is connected to two neighboring computers, forming a closed loop.
Data passes from one computer to another around the ring.
In Mesh Topology, computers are connected by direct links; in a full mesh, every computer is connected to every other computer.
Mesh topology is reliable, but it requires many connections and is expensive.

modelAnswer: Defining a problem means clearly identifying and understanding what must be solved.
It includes determining the problem's requirements, inputs, and expected outputs.

items.followUp: What is a feasible solution to a problem?

rubric.why: Defines a candidate solution as a possible or proposed answer to a problem.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing a candidate solution as a possible or proposed solution.

rubric.why: Explains that the candidate solution is assessed against the problem.
rubric.description: Solves the problem or meets requirements
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it is evaluated to see whether it solves the problem or meets its requirements.

modelAnswer: A candidate solution is a possible solution proposed for a problem.
It is evaluated to see whether it solves the problem and meets its requirements.
